name: PolyMC
tagline: A custom launcher for Minecraft that allows you to easily manage multiple installations of Minecraft at once
blurb: PolyMC is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability, and simplicity.
description:
PolyMC is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability, and simplicity.

Features:

• Easily install game modifications, such as Fabric, Forge, and Quilt

• Control your Java settings

• Manage worlds and resource packs from the launcher

• See logs and other details easily

• Kill Minecraft in case of a crash/freeze

• Isolate Minecraft instances to keep everything clean

• Install and update mods directly from the launcher

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
